_teacher_notes.chapter: Chapters 3 and 12: presentation topology and optional integrations
_teacher_notes.purpose: Add parent/guest display relationships and non-secret integration endpoints without changing Ansible group membership.
_teacher_notes.inputs: Stable manifest host IDs, local Prometheus URL, optional local UniFi controller URL, and deliberate offline-device exceptions.
_teacher_notes.outputs: Browser tree placement plus server-side UniFi configuration. Unknown top-level keys are ignored by current consumers.
change_instructions: Never put the UniFi API key or another secret in this browser-served file.
A node key must match the exact host ID written to reports/manifest.json.
Topology changes affect display only; inventory controls collection and action eligibility.
After editing, validate JSON, run server/layout tests, publish the dashboard, and test the UniFi endpoint.
